## Figure 3.2: Debtor Reporting System Reporting Timetable, 2020–25
Type: grouped bar chart

- **Unit:** Percent
- **Y-axis:** Percent, from **0 to 100**
- **X-axis:** Years **2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025**
- **Legend / series:** **March**, **April**, **June**, **Late reporters and nonreporters**
- **Time span:** 2020–25

### Values by year and reporting status
Values are estimated from bar heights because no printed data labels are shown.

| Year | March | April | June | Late reporters and nonreporters |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2020 | ≈47 | ≈68 | ≈87 | ≈13 |
| 2021 | ≈45 | ≈66 | ≈88 | ≈12 |
| 2022 | ≈48 | ≈74 | ≈90 | ≈9 |
| 2023 | ≈51 | ≈80 | ≈95 | ≈7 |
| 2024 | ≈48 | ≈72 | ≈92 | ≈8 |
| 2025 | ≈56 | ≈82 | ≈94 | ≈6 |

### Rankings and comparisons
- In **every year**, **June** has the highest percentage, followed by **April**, then **March**.
- **Late reporters and nonreporters** is the smallest category in every year.
- The **highest** bar in the figure is **June 2023** at **≈95 percent**.
- The **lowest** bar is **Late reporters and nonreporters 2025** at **≈6 percent**.
- Among **March** values, **2025** is the highest at **≈56 percent**; **2021** is the lowest at **≈45 percent**.
- Among **April** values, **2025** is the highest at **≈82 percent**; **2021** is the lowest at **≈66 percent**.
- Among **June** values, **2023** is the highest at **≈95 percent**; **2020** is the lowest at **≈87 percent**.
- Among **Late reporters and nonreporters**, **2020** is the highest at **≈13 percent** and **2025** the lowest at **≈6 percent**.

### Trends
- **March** rises overall from **≈47 percent in 2020** to **≈56 percent in 2025**, with dips in **2021** and **2024**.
- **April** increases overall from **≈68 percent in 2020** to **≈82 percent in 2025**, peaking first in **2023** before dipping in **2024** and rising again in **2025**.
- **June** remains consistently high, moving from the high 80s in **2020–21** to around **90–95 percent** in **2022–25**.
- **Late reporters and nonreporters** declines overall from about **13 percent** in **2020** to about **6 percent** in **2025**.

**Source:** World Bank Group Debtor Reporting System database.
